title: fix a few refs to master
description: I noticed my codecov badge was linked to master in a package where I have "main" instead, and then remembered your tweet so here are a few more things that "broke" :wink:

title: Refactor
description: Hey this is a halfway written refactor of the code to match the notation in Monroe more clearly, with some additional comments in the implementation. Before I clean it up, I wanted to run it by you and see if you're interested in this new approach.

title: Change framing for prior
description:
This PR addresses #3 by changing the framing in docs throughout (README, vignette, `.Rd`) for the weighting implemented in the current function.

Other changes include:

- more terms are now included in the variance computation
- the naive (unweighted) log odds can be returned in addition to the main weighted result
